sources.entry: MRRDock - Menu bar app that adds up your MRR from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments and Gumroad, keeping the API keys in the macOS Keychain.

summary.one_liner: MRRDock is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that reads subscription revenue from Stripe, RevenueCat, Paddle, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo Payments, Gumroad and custom HTTPS endpoints, sums it into one MRR figure, and keeps API keys in the Keychain.
summary.what_it_does: It polls each configured payment platform directly from the Mac every 15 minutes by default (configurable from 5 minutes to 6 hours) and converts all sources into a display currency using exchange rates cached for 12 hours. It shows the total in the menu bar in several modes (MRR, MRR with 30-day change, ARR, 28-day revenue, active subscriptions, cycling per source, or icon only) and offers a popover with per-source breakdown, trend chart, and a privacy mode that hides figures. Each MRR figure is computed per line item (yearly divided by 12, trials excluded, percentage coupons applied), and usage-based prices are flagged as unpriced rather than guessed. It can send MRR milestone and daily summary notifications to Discord or Slack webhooks. Gumroad contributes 28-day revenue only, since it has no subscription ledger.
use_cases: track MRR across several payment platforms
see current monthly recurring revenue in the menu bar
combine Stripe and RevenueCat revenue into one total
get Discord or Slack alerts on revenue milestones
monitor SaaS or indie app revenue without opening dashboards
feed custom revenue data into a menu bar tracker
how_to_run: git clone <repository URL> (URL not given in README)
swift run MRRDock  # alternative: run from SwiftPM
notable: Sums MRR across several accounts of the same platform and several platforms in one converted total
API keys stored in macOS Keychain; app issues only read-only GET requests
Usage-based or tiered prices are reported as unpriced instead of being estimated
Custom HTTPS endpoint source lets users route any revenue API or private billing data into the total
No server, no account, no analytics; data stored as local JSON
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; no Windows or Linux version
Gumroad provides revenue only, no MRR; App Store Connect and Google Play are not yet supported directly
Totals may differ from provider dashboards because fixed-amount coupons are not applied and usage-based prices are excluded
keywords: see my revenue in menu bar
track subscription income from several platforms
